verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Google Authenticator-to-Google Authenticator bulk migration: an export QR on the old device that the new device scans, plus Google Account sync. Nothing shows the app importing tokens from other authenticator apps. Same-app device transfer is an adjacent feature, not cross-app import, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
